description.value: The Prestige Oceanview Hotel Prince Rupert is a full-service hotel steps from the Inner Harbour in Prince Rupert, offering ocean views, a complimentary breakfast buffet with hot waffle bar, a fitness room, and free parking. It is part of the Prestige Hotels & Resorts family of 19 BC properties and caters to both leisure and business travellers. Prince Rupert is a key gateway to the BC Ferries Inside Passage route and Alaska, making this hotel a practical stop for long-distance touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active hotel at 118 6th Street, Prince Rupert, BC, with matching phone (250.624.6711) and email (PrinceRupert@PrestigeHotels.ca). The website consistently brands the property as 'Prestige Oceanview Hotel Prince Rupert' rather than the OSM name 'Prestige Prince Rupert Hotel' — a name discrepancy worth flagging. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website; Wi-Fi and a complimentary breakfast buffet are explicitly confirmed amenities.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records name as 'Prestige Prince Rupert Hotel' but the hotel's own website consistently uses 'Prestige Oceanview Hotel Prince Rupert' — OSM name may be outdated or informal.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel in a key cyclist gateway city. Confirmed open with current website content.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Complimentary deluxe breakfast buffet with hot waffle bar included for guests; described as starting early on both weekdays and weekends
